title: JVM Internals & Performance
intro: JVM internals interview questions show up in every senior Java backend interview — class loading, the runtime memory areas (heap, stack, metaspace), garbage collection (G1, ZGC, Shenandoah, when to pick which), JIT compilation, escape analysis, and the diagnostic tools you reach for in a production incident (jstack, jmap, async-profiler, JFR). This page covers the questions that test depth: "walk me through what happens between System.out.println and the bytes hitting the kernel", "why is this app's tail latency so bad", "how would you tune the GC for a high-throughput service". Each answer is structured for an interview, not a textbook — concept first, then the trade-offs.
